audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 2 and 3 disagree with packet.levelChart and with their own whys. Page: Lillia/Skill/Malphite/Malphite/Lillia/Malphite/Malphite. Packet: Malphite/Skill/Skill/Skill/Lillia/Malphite/Malphite. whys[0] ends "concede and farm", whys[2] ends "yet his slow keeps the trade even", whys[3] ends "genuinely even".
audit.why: Row 0 is the worst of the three: the page awards Level 1 to Lillia and prints a sentence underneath telling the player to concede it.
audit.corrected: phases[0]/win[0] -> Malphite, phases[2]/win[2] -> Skill, phases[3]/win[3] -> Skill, with ratings 3/10, 5/10, 5/10. phases[0].why, phases[2].why and phases[3].why rewritten so the full layer matches.

audit.whatIsWrong: Unstoppable Force is the tracked cooldown of the whole page and is never numbered; dosFull[2].d invents "the fifteen-second invitation" for a 130/115/100s ultimate. Seismic Shard's flat 8s — the cooldown that actually governs lane — appears nowhere.
audit.why: A baited ultimate at rank 1 gives you 130 seconds, and the thing that decides whether you can walk away from any given trade is the 8-second Q, not the ult.
audit.corrected: 130s at rank 1 into dosFull[2].d and breakdown.cooldowns; the 8s Seismic Shard into breakdown.cooldowns and phases[3].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors. (a) tldr and report[0].t say "he has no way to stop the jog". Seismic Shard steals Move Speed from you for 3 seconds, and both Q and E carry grounding — stopping the jog is precisely what his kit does. (b) whys[4], spikes[1].text, content.mid and wants.you[1] all promise a counter-sleep on his Unstoppable Force without stating Lilting Lullaby's precondition: it only affects enemies already carrying Dream Dust. A Malphite who has not been hit by one of your skills cannot be slept at all, mid-engage or otherwise.
audit.why: (a) is the single claim the matchup is built on and it is false. (b) is the difference between a plan and a coin flip — the mirror malphite__lillia now teaches the same precondition from his side, as 'break contact after she lands a skill'.
audit.corrected: tldr and report[0].t now name the 3-second speed steal. whys[4] and spikes[1].text now lead with the Dream Dust requirement before the counter-sleep.

notes: Both packet.suspectNames entries are false positives: "Hold Lilting Lullaby" and "His Seismic Shard" are the correct names with a verb and a pronoun in front. No edits made for those. UNVERIFIED and deliberately untouched: content.mid still says you can "sleep him as he commits Unstoppable Force". Whether Lilting Lullaby's Drowsy can be applied to, or survives, a knock-up dash in progress is not in Riot's text and not in the kit files — the mirror malphite__lillia hit the same wall from the other direction and removed its reciprocal "knock-up cancels her R" claim for the same reason. I added the Dream Dust precondition, which IS verifiable, but did not assert or deny the mid-dash timing. If you can confirm that timing one way or the other it is worth a proper rewrite of whys[4], spikes[1], mid and wants.you[1] together, since all four rest on it.
